digest.component_or_area: ruff linting configuration and src/rebar code
propositions: ruff ARG rule violations (72 initially, 64 after prior cleanup) across src/rebar reveal accepted-then-unused parameters, including three tracked real defects and many safe-to-rename cases

Cluster-1 reconciler leaf handlers (10 sites) use runtime string introspection on parameter names in typed_dispatch.py, making naive renames unsafe; normalization to **_kwargs preserves dispatch behavior while removing violations

Cluster-2 OutboundMapper Protocol implementations (7 sites across two backends) pass parameters by keyword and are bound by Protocol structural typing; renaming breaks contracts across call sites and implementations

Renaming unused parameters is not universally safe despite common assumption; ARG gate cannot be enabled without carrying ~17 permanent noqa exceptions due to keyword-passing and interface constraints

Post-sweep ARG violations reduced from 64 to 21 irreducible floor: 2 tracked defects excluded, 10 Cluster-1 leaves normalized, 7 Protocol params left raw, 12 keyword/doc-pinned params left raw, remainder safe-renamed
